mechanism_narrative: Sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.5% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% (UNRATE > 6.0%) signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with UNRATE > 6.0 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in housing starts (HOUST > 0.5% MoM) and industrial production (INDPRO > 0.5% MoM) indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with both HOUST and INDPRO rising >0.5% MoM or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising >0.25pp in 3 months) increase discount rates and borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during FEDFUNDS tightening cycles or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 1.0% annualized) signals sustained economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with GDPC1 growth > 1.0% annualized or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals economic contraction and reduced corporate output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO < 100 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS > 0.3% MoM) and falling unemployment (UNRATE falling >0.1pp MoM) indicate a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS growth >0.3% MoM and UNRATE fall >0.1pp MoM or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, high housing starts (HOUST > 1800) signal potential overheating and impending slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion with HOUST > 1800 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
